notes: Hook keeps the customer's spelling ('q ja usei') instead of the concept's normalised 'QUE JÁ USEI'. Second print is shown only down to 'e com o suporte.' so the line about 'lucro' (possible real-money earnings) stays out of frame. No competitor names appear. The terminal label repeats the verbatim fragment 'desde a minha época de tibia'. Peak adds a 'COMPLETO' stamp (echoing both prints' word) and the approved-claim chip 'o bot farma 100% AFK'. Orchestrator edit: the end-card ask, captions and pinned comment no longer invite talk about Tibia (a third-party game where botting is banned) and #tibia was replaced by #mmorpg; the verbatim quote still shows the customer's own words. Ask max-width 700 px to stay inside the right-rail line.
